title: Schedule
summary: Find details on where to meet us in person at upcoming events, tradeshows and conferences.
body_markdown:
Find details on where to meet us in person at upcoming events, tradeshows and conferences.


###


OVIN Partner Forum


###


- Oct 7


A Palitronica representative will be at the


**University of Toronto** on October 7th for the Ontario Vehicle Innovation Network (OVIN) Partner Forum.


###


**Hydro-** Québec


###


-


**Oct 7-8** ****


Palitronica's Co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer, Sebastian Fischmeister, will be delivering a presentation at the Hydro-Québec 2026 in


**Montreal, Quebec** .


###


AUSA Annual Meeting & Exposition – Oct 12-14


Palitronica executives will be attending the AUSA Annual Meeting & Expos in


**Washington, DC** , connecting with defence leaders, technology providers, and industry stakeholders across the US defence ecosystem.


**Polytechnique Montréal – Oct 15-16**


Palitronica’s Co-founder, Sebastian Fischmeister, will be presenting at Polytechnique Montréal in


**Montreal, Quebec,** on October 15-16.


****


**Best Defence Conference**


**– Oct 20-21**


Palitronica will be exhibiting at the Best Defence Conference in


**London, ON** , connecting with organizations and leaders across Canada’s defence sector.


**CyberPUCV – Oct 22**


Sebastian Fischmeister, will deliver a keynote at CyberPUCV at the Chilean Naval Academy in


**Valparaíso, Chile** .


**IEEE PAINE Conference – Oct 27-29**


Palitronica will be participating in the IEEE International Conference on Physical Assurance and Inspection of Electronics (PAINE) in


**Phoenix, Arizona** .


#####


Electronica – Nov 10-13


Palitronica’s CEO Matthew Monteyne, will be attending the annual event in


**Munich, Germany** , connecting with manufacturers, suppliers, and technology leaders from across the global electronics industry.


**INCYBER Forum – Dec 1-3**


Palitronica’s Co-founder, Sebastian Fischmeister, will be exhibiting at Canada's INCYBER Forum in


**Ottawa, ON,** from December 1–3, connecting with cybersecurity leaders, organizations, and industry experts.


Follow


[Palitronica on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/palitronica-inc/) to get event updates.
